{{Term/Store|Lightning-Proof||Series, EoW}},{{Exp Game|EoW}}<ref name="EoW Game Screen"/> also stylized as {{Term/Store|Lightning Proof||BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Guide"/><ref name="TotK Guide"/> and also known as '''Unshockable''',{{Exp Game|BotW}}<ref name="BotW Guide"/> is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Overview==
==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}===
Lightning Proof is an [[Added Effect]] and [[Set Bonus]] that prevents [[Link]] from taking any damage from [[Electricity]] or [[Lightning]] strikes. It also prevents any negative effects from either, such as being knocked back or disarmed.

In {{BotW}}, Lightning Proof as an Added Effect is imparted by the [[Thunder Helm]]. It is known as Unshockable as a Set Bonus, which is granted by the [[Rubber Set]] (★★).

In {{TotK}}, Lightning Proof is available as the Added Effect on the [[Lightning Helm]]. It is also found on the Rubber Set (★★) again.

==={{EoW|-}}===
In {{EoW}}, Lightning-Proof is an [[Added Effect]] granted by certain [[Potion]]s and [[Smoothie]]s made using [[Electro Apple]]s. All of these drinks have either "Apple" or "Electro" in their names. While the effect is active, it prevents [[Princess Zelda]] from taking any damage from [[Electricity]].

The following drinks provide Zelda with Lightning-Proof when consumed:
